sections.title: Reporting deadlines
sections.sql: SELECT code,agreement,due_on,status,exception_count,currency,earned_cents FROM period_position WHERE closed_at IS NULL ORDER BY due_on

sections.title: Sales to review
sections.sql: SELECT reference,agreement,product,issue FROM sale_review WHERE issue<>'' ORDER BY reference

sections.title: Follow-ups
sections.sql: SELECT a.code,f.note,f.owner,f.due_on FROM followups f JOIN agreements a ON a.id=f.agreement_id WHERE f.closed_at IS NULL ORDER BY f.due_on

sections.title: Whole-term minimum exposure
sections.note: Eligible earned royalties only. Exceptions are excluded. No cross-currency aggregation. This is not a payment instruction.
sections.sql: SELECT code,name,currency,minimum_cents,earned_cents,guarantee_gap_cents FROM guarantee_position ORDER BY code

sections.title: Advance comparison and unresolved sales
sections.note: Not a recoupment schedule or amount payable. Review the signed contract before settling.
sections.sql: SELECT code,currency,advance_cents,earned_above_advance_cents,unresolved_sales FROM guarantee_position ORDER BY code

sections.title: Policy and contract findings
sections.sql: SELECT record,rule,finding FROM compliance_findings ORDER BY rule,record
